title: English Practice Quiz 0625
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: What does 'borrow' mean?
options: take something temporarily and return it
questions.explanation: Borrow means to take something for a period and return it.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.
